description.narrative: Sida stödjer UNHABITATs projekt ”Yangon Informal Settlements – Resettlement”. Insatsen är ett begränsat stöd till en pilotfas. Projektets målgrupp är människor som bor i slumområden i Yangon och syftar till att minimera de risker som en omflyttning av människor innebär

Sida supports UNHABITAT project Yangon Informal Settlements – Resettlement. The intervention is a limited pilot support. The project aims to mitigate resettlement risks and increase protection for households relocated/resettled from informal settlements residing in hazardous locations in Yangon.

The goal of the project is to mitigate resettlement risks and increase protection for households relocated/ resettled from informal settlements located in hazardous locations in Yangon's resettlement areas. Specifically the outcome is expected to be: - Reduction in resettlement risks and increased protection for participating households - Relocation/ resettlement is voluntary rather than forced through engagement with households targeted under the programme - Proper planning of settlements and plan for economic development - Housing opportunities created for poor and low-income households - Increased government capacity in resettlement with development planning
